quotes.text: Enter your email to request access.
Enter a SIRET, postal code, and store name. The SIRET and postal code you provide must match for the restaurant to be onboarded successfully.
The open drawer displays the restaurant’s status, the supported card issuers, and the Payment Location ID.
A restaurant displays an `Ineligible` status when Conecs (the French meal voucher network) rejects the restaurant’s SIRET during onboarding validation.
If the SIRET is incorrect, create a new onboarding request with the correct SIRET after resolving the issue.

old_evidence.text: The Stripe API for onboarding restaurants to accept French meal vouchers payments is in preview and is only available for select preview users.
You can see the restaurant’s status and the supported card issuers.

findings: Both captures require a CNTR license and a contract with every intended issuer from the supported Bimpli, Pluxee and Up Déjeuner set. Dashboard Add SIRET requires the establishment SIRET, postal code and store name. The SIRET and postal code must match. The Dashboard prevents editing SIRET and name after creation. Validation and issuer determination take 1–2 business days after submission. Verify successful restaurant onboarding before accepting payments and inspect each issuer status separately (old raw lines 6-51, new raw lines 7-56).

Both captures document opening the selected connected account’s payment settings and configuring its SIRETs under French Meal Voucher Conecs. They provide the same examples for successful onboarding, awaiting response and postal-code mismatch. These are test fixtures, and connected-account Dashboard navigation gives no evidence of charge-type support, enabled capabilities, payment success or settlement (old raw lines 71-91, new raw lines 88-106).

Add reciprocal dated warnings at the setup summary, wiki/sources/source-stripe-fr-meal-vouchers-accept-payment.md:19-26 and wiki/concepts/stripe-fr-meal-vouchers.md:49-55,90. The May 5 acceptance guide passes the branch SIRET in `payment_details[benefit][fr_meal_voucher][siret]`. The November server-side PaymentIntent passes a `loc_` PaymentLocation ID in `payment_details[location]` and sets `payment_details[benefit][fr_meal_voucher][enabled]=if_payment_method_is_eligible`. A created location or an issuer listing can precede acceptance readiness. Verify the `fr_meal_vouchers_conecs_payments` capability is `active` on that location. Keep the preview API request version `2026-05-27.preview` or later scoped to the separate November integration, and distinguish the server request from client confirmation. Stripe resolves SIRET at confirmation, with changes before confirmation potentially applying and already-confirmed payments unaffected (new raw lines 44-56, raw/stripe-fr-meal-vouchers-accept-payment-2025.md:31-45, raw/stripe-payments-meal-vouchers-fr-meal-vouchers-accept-a-payment-2026-11-07.md:24-62, raw/stripe-payments-meal-vouchers-fr-meal-vouchers-set-up-restaurant-api-2026-11-07.md:130-172).

November adds the Dashboard `Ineligible` state when Conecs rejects a nonexistent SIRET, a SIRET without CNTR approval, or a SIRET whose CNTR approval was revoked. Verify the SIRET and obtain or re-obtain the CNTR license. For a wrong SIRET, create a new Dashboard onboarding request. For a correct SIRET with pending registration, Stripe automatically resumes once Conecs processes registration. Separately, an invalid postal code follows the `Requires Action` drawer → Update Details → correct postal code → Confirm path, with a status update in 1–2 business days (new raw lines 62-86).

The separate November API example for a nonexistent SIRET or missing CNTR approval returns `fr_meal_vouchers_conecs_payments` in `pending` with `business_registration.siret` currently due. Keep this specific example separate from the Dashboard `Ineligible` label and its broader set of causes, including revoked approval. For an incorrect SIRET, the API corrects the existing PaymentLocation and the Dashboard creates a new request. For relevant changes after activation in the API, pass `onboarding_data_update_acknowledged=true`. Re-onboarding puts the capability back into `pending`, with acceptance unavailable until onboarding completes (new raw lines 62-86, raw/stripe-payments-meal-vouchers-fr-meal-vouchers-set-up-restaurant-api-2026-11-07.md:261-310).

answers.Q1: The November capture of https://docs.stripe.com/payments/meal-vouchers/fr-meal-vouchers/set-up-restaurant documents Stripe Dashboard onboarding per restaurant for Bimpli, Pluxee and Up Déjeuner. The restaurant needs CNTR licensing and agreements with each intended issuer. Add SIRET takes the SIRET, postal code and store name, and the SIRET/postal pair must match. The Dashboard prevents changing the restaurant’s name and SIRET after creation. After validation in 1–2 business days, check successful onboarding and issuer statuses before attempting payment. November also shows a Payment Location ID in the drawer, distinct from the SIRET and connected-account identity (old raw lines 6-51, new raw lines 7-56). In both captures, a postal mismatch can reach Requires Action and be corrected in Dashboard, Connect setup is for the selected connected account, and test SIRETs model successful, pending and mismatched onboarding (old raw lines 53-91, new raw lines 76-106). November adds the Dashboard `Ineligible` state when Conecs rejects a nonexistent SIRET, a SIRET without CNTR approval, or a SIRET whose CNTR approval was revoked. Verify the SIRET and obtain or re-obtain the CNTR license. For a wrong SIRET, create a new Dashboard onboarding request. For a correct SIRET with pending registration, Stripe automatically resumes once Conecs processes registration. Separately, an invalid postal code follows the `Requires Action` drawer → Update Details → correct postal code → Confirm path, with a status update in 1–2 business days (new raw lines 62-86). source-stripe-fr-meal-vouchers-setup-restaurant.md covers the May flow but overstates field matching and Requires Action, and its preview notes need dates and its new location-based handoff needs a reciprocal link.
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/meal-vouchers/fr-meal-vouchers/set-up-restaurant, the substantive November changes are the explicit private-preview waitlist, the added Payment Location ID and handoff to acceptance, and the Ineligible branch for Conecs rejection, with a new Dashboard request for an incorrect SIRET and automatic resumption after Conecs processes a pending CNTR registration for a correct SIRET. Keep May's select-user API preview and email contact dated. Changes to repeated Dashboard step headings, hyperlinks and table layout do not change the shared Dashboard and Connect procedure (old raw lines 8-18, old raw lines 24-91, new raw lines 9-25, new raw lines 31-106). In source-stripe-fr-meal-vouchers-setup-restaurant.md and reciprocal acceptance and concept references, preserve the May 5, 2026 branch SIRET field payment_details[benefit][fr_meal_voucher][siret] (raw/stripe-fr-meal-vouchers-accept-payment-2025.md:31-45). The November server-side PaymentIntent instead sends a loc_ PaymentLocation ID in payment_details[location] plus payment_details[benefit][fr_meal_voucher][enabled]=if_payment_method_is_eligible. Before accepting, require the location’s fr_meal_vouchers_conecs_payments capability to be active. An issuer listing or newly created location can precede activation. The separate private-preview API flow requires Stripe API 2026-05-27.preview or later; Stripe resolves the SIRET at payment confirmation (raw/stripe-payments-meal-vouchers-fr-meal-vouchers-accept-a-payment-2026-11-07.md:24-62, raw/stripe-payments-meal-vouchers-fr-meal-vouchers-set-up-restaurant-api-2026-11-07.md:130-172). In the API’s nonexistent or unapproved SIRET example, the capability is pending with business_registration.siret due. This example does not map every Dashboard Ineligible case to an API status. Whereas the Dashboard creates a new request for a wrong SIRET, the API updates the existing location. For relevant changes after activation, send onboarding_data_update_acknowledged=true and expect the capability to return to pending with acceptance suspended during re-onboarding (raw/stripe-payments-meal-vouchers-fr-meal-vouchers-set-up-restaurant-api-2026-11-07.md:261-310). Waitlist requests and test fixtures give no evidence of account activation, payment or settlement.
